evidence_class: Static; no compilation, Rust/Python test, candidate replay, physical run, or target run by reviewer
scope: BVLS03 p0/p1/p2 seam guards, admission subtraction, and partial-work category retention

reviewed_delta.moving_source_limit: The live Stage1 source was changing in a separate tranche; this review binds only the two preserved copies.

findings.finding: saturating_sub silently converts an eligibility delta greater than the authorized K/G bound into zero remaining reservation. This could admit a face whose later work is no longer covered by the finite cap proof.
findings.required_correction: Use checked subtraction. If the already-executed eligibility delta exceeds the per-face scalar or guard bound, return the owning typed work-cap/accounting refusal before correction work.

findings.finding: The fixed E(m) seam guards remain incomplete. The box helper charges one event for two separately evaluated lower/upper comparisons; active admission does not charge the separately executed active-value bit equality; p0 free assembly/equality and all p0/p1/p2 radius comparisons remain uncharged.
findings.required_correction: Increment each fixed semantic seam event immediately before it executes and retain short-circuit partial counts. Keep predicates within one source/result admission grouped as one event. Bind the successful-path totals to p0=85+m, p1=43+m, and p2=85 without changing eligibility or refusal precedence.

findings.finding: p1 rejected-box observation currently reuses the all-21-coordinate box helper. The authority permits an inactive free-coordinate box violation and fixes the p1 seam bound as 43+m; the checked coordinate set and lower/upper event count must match that derivation.
findings.required_correction: Use or explicitly demonstrate the authority-derived free-coordinate p1 rejected-box check while preserving full original-box checks for p0 and p2.

accepted_changes: The Stage1 module is itself compiled only under cfg(test), so the cfg(test) eligibility snapshots are present whenever this module compiles; they are not a production compile defect.
Both residual refusal arms absorb partial Dot2 counters and now retain their partial arithmetic in first_residual_operations/second_dot2_operations.
Both factor applications snapshot the scalar ledger before lambda_step and assign their category delta before mapping an error, preserving partial failure work.
Both factor-output validation loops absorb counters on success and at the first refusal.
Coordinate updates absorb the helper's exact arithmetic/guard counters and retain partial failure work rather than substituting a manual success-only charge.
p1 box feasibility is computed from the actual private scratch vector and carried into the observation rather than inferred from p2 or a canned flag.
SVD no-convergence now uses state_refusal, retaining prior monotonic ledger work.
residual_risk_and_missing_tests: A stable fix cut must prove exact successful E(m) totals, short-circuit refusal counts, and checked admission subtraction.
Refusal metadata fields and controller propagation are separate open review scopes.
verdict: BLOCKED on three concrete seam/admission defects; accepted partial-work retention changes may be retained.
